purpose: Text-to-speech list prices from five vendors, read live from their own pricing pages for the `elevenlabs alternatives` page. Price only: voice quality, latency, voice cloning and languages are NOT priced here.

offers.quote: Chirp 3: HD voices | 0 to 1 million characters | US$0.00003 per character (US$30 per 1 million characters)
